metadata.detail: Reports public episodic, vector, graph, transcript, lifecycle, priming, app-session, and last-context metrics. Empty stores report zero; unavailable or unconfigured components are labeled honestly.

metadata.name: meta
metadata.description: List active meta insights with lifecycle and provenance metadata.
metadata.detail: Queries typed short- and long-term meta_insight records, excludes decayed records, and shows bounded synthesis provenance, source, confidence, and verification fields when available. It never runs synthesis or reorganization.

metadata.name: reorganize
metadata.description: Preview or explicitly execute coordinated memory reorganization.

arguments.name: --execute
arguments.description: Apply changes (exact flag required; a verified recovery bundle is always created first).

arguments.name: mode
arguments.description: Run one reorganization step instead of the full operation.

arguments.name: --skip-synthesis
arguments.description: Skip synthesis during a full run.

arguments.name: --skip-verify
arguments.description: Skip verification during a full run.

arguments.name: --skip-lifecycle
arguments.description: Skip lifecycle processing.

arguments.name: --force-reembed
arguments.description: Force eligible records to be re-embedded.

arguments.name: --recover <run-id>
arguments.description: Inspect a retained run; add exact --execute to restore its recorded verified bundle.

metadata.detail: The command is dry-run by default. Full mode runs dedupe, prune, synthesis, verification, and lifecycle unless a full-only skip flag is supplied. --analyze is read-only and rejects --execute. Every mutating mode first creates a verified Memory and Transcript recovery bundle; Transcript content is recovery-only and is never reorganized. Plain 'execute' and --no-backup are rejected. Recovery artifacts and the owner-only categorical log are retained; use the exact --recover forms shown above after recovery_required. Automatic exit reorganization is separately configurable and defaults to disabled.

metadata.detail: With no target, queries the runtime's current session identity. Selected identifiers are bound store-query values, never paths. The export target writes deterministic sessions.csv and entries.csv beneath a safely contained timestamped export directory.
